provenance.keySource: A question is authenticated when its printed NTA question id is in the 24-05-2026 (First) final key for subject 306 and the key option id is one of its four printed option ids. Printed option ids are consecutive per question.

openCallsSettled.Q701 (n26): Not covered (A: covered, weaker call). The wavelength step is Class 12 NCERT (Table 5.3) and is not served.
openCallsSettled.Q702 (n27): Covered. Bank b19fa8e5 orders 4-methoxy < benzoic < 4-nitro; bank 4f290de0 and the CCl3/CHCl2 card teach that acidity grows with the number of withdrawing groups, which places 2,4-dinitrobenzoic acid last.
openCallsSettled.Q709 (n34): Covered. Each step (diazotisation, hypophosphorous-acid deamination, alkaline KMnO4 side-chain oxidation) is served; the printed "H3PO4" is a misprint for H3PO2 and option 1 is the only diazotise-reduce-oxidise sequence.
openCallsSettled.Q679 (n4): Covered. B classes it numerical (ion counting for i); bank 922a8389 does the same count, and cards keep the complex ion whole.
openCallsSettled.Q691 (n16): Covered. Bank 6b359ce9 sums the powers of a rate law with a fractional power; a negative power is the same addition.
openCallsSettled.Q677 (n2), Q714 (n39), Q723 (n48), Q690: Not covered, agreeing with A: the keyed name (methylene chloride), the tryptophan pair, the -CHCl2 phenoxide structure, the N2O5 statement and the pH direction are not served.
openCallsSettled.Q719 (n44): Covered and not skill: the passage gives the reaction but not what a reducing agent is; served cards make the oxidised metal the reductant.
